CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real AABB overlap detection in apps/mapeditor's add command -- warns (doesn't block) if a new object's bounding box overlaps an existing one's. Verified live: overlapping placement correctly warned naming the colliding object; non-overlapping and near-miss-boundary placements correctly produced no false positive. bazel build/test //... clean. Commit ef38512. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
